views.text: Decrypt App Store apps directly on your jailbroken iPhone.

views.markdown:
Features
  • Browse and search installed apps
  • Decrypt the currently installed version
  • Download and decrypt the latest App Store version
  • Download and decrypt the latest version compatible with your iOS
  • Select, install, or decrypt an exact historical App Store version
  • Install a selected version without decrypting it
  • View live progress and copy logs
  • Share completed IPA files
  • Open the decrypted output folder in Filza
  • View and refresh Apple ID authentication status
Compatibility
  • Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks
  • iOS 14 through iOS 17
  • Requires AppSync Unified and appinst
  • Some newer SC_Info formats and certain arm64e apps may not decrypt

v0.7.3-korboy.2
  • Fixed Apple authentication status appearing invalid after reopening the app
  • Authentication status now restores and verifies correctly
  • Prevented old authentication checks from overwriting newer results
  • Improved authentication reliability and app-state handling
v0.7.3-korboy.1
  • Added installation of selected App Store versions without decrypting

  • Improved Apple ID authentication validation and refresh behavior
  • Added dynamic App Store authentication endpoint discovery

  • Preserved failed decryption output for troubleshooting
  • Improved build reliability and upstream compatibility
v0.7.0-korboy.1
